About Sparks International School

Sparks International School is committed to providing quality education in a safe, caring, and inspiring environment. We focus on academic excellence along with Islamic Tarbiyah, strong moral values, discipline, character building, creativity, sports, and co-curricular activities.

visibility

Our Vision

To nurture confident, knowledgeable, disciplined, and responsible individuals who excel academically while living by Islamic teachings and strong moral values.

flag

Our Mission

To provide quality education in a safe, caring, and inspiring environment while developing students through academic excellence, Islamic Tarbiyah, moral values, and character building.

psychology

Our Philosophy

True education develops both the mind and the character — combining modern learning with Islamic teachings, creativity, sports, and co-curricular activities.

Our Leadership

Guiding Sparks with visionary excellence and dedication to shaping the next generation.

Sir Asad Iqbal

Director & Founder

Sir Asad Iqbal is an inspiring, charismatic, and visionary leader with over 25 years of educational expertise across Pakistan and the UAE. Certified by ADEK (UAE), USA, and UK institutions. Dedicated to establishing safe, inclusive, and high-performing learning environments.

"True education elevates the mind with knowledge, grounds the heart in Islamic Tarbiyah as our first priority, and empowers youth to serve humanity with faith, noble character, and excellence."

Sir Abdul Rahman Asad

Director

Sir Abdul Rahman Asad brings dynamic leadership to Sparks International School, supporting the vision of quality education combined with strong moral values and character development.
